Package com.framed.communicator.driver.protocol.mimic

Record Class WfdbSignal

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.framed.communicator.driver.protocol.mimic.WfdbSignal
Record Components:
fileName - name of the .dat file holding this signal's samples (relative to the header), or "~" for a layout-header placeholder signal
format - WFDB storage format code (e.g. 80, 16, 212)
byteOffset - preamble length in bytes to skip at the start of fileName (the +N decorator on the format field; 0 if absent)
gain - ADC units per physical unit; 0 means uncalibrated
baseline - ADC value corresponding to a physical value of 0
units - physical unit string (e.g. "mV", "mmHg"); may be null
description - human-readable signal name (e.g. "II", "PLETH", "ABP")
public record WfdbSignal(String fileName, int format, int byteOffset, double gain, int baseline, String units, String description) extends Record
The specification of a single signal, as declared on one signal-specification line of a WFDB header file.

All fields are taken verbatim from the header; the physical value of a raw ADC sample is recovered with toPhysical(int) using the WFDB convention physical = (adc - baseline) / gain. A gain of 0 marks the signal as uncalibrated: no physical unit is defined and the raw ADC value is passed through unchanged (see uncalibrated()).
